an7.60:1.1: sattahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu nacirasseva āsavānaṃ khayā …pe… sacchikatvā upasampajja vihareyya.
an7.60:1.3: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu saddho hoti sīlavā hoti bahussuto hoti paṭisallīno hoti āraddhaviriyo hoti satimā hoti paññavā hoti
an7.60:1.4: imehi kho bhikkhave sattahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu nacirasseva āsavānaṃ khayā …pe… sacchikatvā upasampajja vihareyyāti.
